title: Hoshino Ichika — Leo/need〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
School was great today!
I can't wait for tomorrow♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You really like school, you weirdo.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's not to like about spending the day with my friends!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's nice that we're all going to the same school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I missed it so much, I'm just loving every day of it♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess I'm having more fun too now that you're back.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we can always talk about band stuff, and ask for advice with anything that didn't go so well when rehearsing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh? Ichika, are you having some problems you want to discuss?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not at the moment, but there's something else I've been thinking about...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, is there any way we can practice without our instruments?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sometimes I want to go over a song when I have some time before a class, but obviously I don't have my guitar with me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I often imagine playing while listening to songs. Other than that, I do finger exercises.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You do what?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She practices the finger movements for playing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, that rings a bell, actually! I had to do that for my piano lessons too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember seeing this scene in my dad's band manga where one artist was using a packet of cigarettes to exercise his fingers.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Using a small box can work, but not a cig box.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That'd get us in trouble at school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As long as it's about the same width as a guitar fret, any box is fine for that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see if we can find one for Ichi, so that she can practice with it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What, now? People may have other stuff to do, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm free. I was just going to go back home after school.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same, I don't have work today. Besides, I know how frustrating it is when you want to practice so bad but don't have the kit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, guys.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... We've been to the convenience store, and the drugstore...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we picked up some boxes from the discount store, too. I think we have a pretty good assortment?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Pick the box you think's the best from your haul! Mine's this, a fancy chocolate bar box!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mine's the bandage box.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The gummies box for me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Everyone went for something different.
I think this candy box is best.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why don't we have Ichika try all of them out?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, except Saki's.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Why's mine no good?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The thickness is okay, but it's too wide.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... I think mine will be too thick.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: None of the boxes is just right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The one I picked isn't perfect either.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mine's about the same size as yours.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case we have no choice but to resort to...DIY!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are we going to...build a box?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You said the chocolate box was the right thickness, but it was too wide, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So we just need to cut it to the right size!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you mean like doing it yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: DIY!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, if you want to call it that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think she just likes the sound of it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's go to my house!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can share this chocolate bar, and then we use the empty box to make a tool for Ichi to practice her fingering!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, okay. Thank you for doing this for me.
